# GetBreakAI Japan (getbreakai.com/jp/)
> Independent Japanese educational research publisher covering New NISA (18M JPY / 12M Growth Limit) & 2000-2025 SMH x XLV historical ETF statistics.

## Primary Free Tools & Live Data
- Free 4-Step New NISA 25-Year Historical Explorer: https://getbreakai.com/jp/
- Live Daily SMH Fear & Greed Index (Japanese 7-Factor Gauge): https://getbreakai.com/jp/smh-fear-greed
- Live Daily SMH Fear & Greed JSON: https://getbreakai.com/data/smh_fg_latest.json
- Free 2-Page New NISA Sample Workbook PDF: https://getbreakai.com/jp/downloads/gba_jp_sample_2p.pdf
- 13 New NISA, US Dividend 10% Tax & Retirement Guides Hub: https://getbreakai.com/jp/guides/

## Public Data Sources & Scope
- Public ETF closing series (SMH, XLV, QQQ) & Japan FSA New NISA rules. Strictly educational reference; zero investment advisory or trade commands.
